scope: Moto inference only. Workstation renders/tokenizes official reference metadata; no model inference outside the Moto.

additional_sampling_control.name: greedy
additional_sampling_control.reason: Inspect whether selecting the highest-probability token avoids observed low-probability pronoun choices. Diagnostic, not automatic adoption or a universal decoding recommendation.

conditioning: Four fixed cases per model: two histories reconstructed with actual previous model replies and two new single-turn controls. Twenty-five full-turn template/tokenizer audits per model.
route_cache_policy: Full recomputation on both routes for this diagnostic, not a proposed production fix.
